description:
Summary:

D101914212 enabled CPU Triton in the AOTI C++ wrapper, but only along the autotune-at-compile-time path. Workloads that disable that flag (e.g., Preproc PT2 lowering, which turns it off to avoid GPU autotune OOM) end up with an empty `CpuTritonKernelCache` because two GPU-only fallbacks were never extended to CPU. This change makes those fallbacks device-aware so CPU + user-defined Triton kernels survive AOTI compile regardless of whether the autotune block runs.

- The two-pass AOTI cpp_wrapper compile in `codegen_with_cpp_wrapper` was gated on cuda/xpu only, so CPU never got the Pass 1 Python-wrapper run whose `.run()` side effects populate the kernel cache.
- `generate_save_uncompiled_kernels` unconditionally called `save_gpu_kernel`, which fails with `KeyError "cubin"` for CPU autotuners (their `compiled.asm` only carries `so` / `launcher.so`).
- `generate_reset_kernel_saved_flags` only reset `cuda_kernel_saved`, leaving stale `cpu_kernel_saved` state across compile passes.

Authored by Claude.

Reviewed By: shawnxu26

Differential Revision: D104795595
